info.description:
Generate AI fashion visuals from your own products, read and write the account's creations and tech packs, publish to Shopify and social accounts, and make Mila, the account's AI agent, work for you.

This document is assembled at the instant of the call: the fixed routes from their descriptions in the code, the workflows from the live catalogue. It is the source the docs page, the `tnb` CLI, the MCP connector and any agent read.

Human documentation: https://thenewblack.ai/clothing_fashion_api_integrations

Read it instead of any table of routes. Its info carries x-workflows-revision (equal to GET /catalog's workflows_revision for the same contracts) and x-openapi-revision (the whole document, the ETag: send it back in If-None-Match and an unchanged document answers 304).

The ETag is the workflows_revision: send it back in If-None-Match and a catalogue that has not changed answers 304.

post.description:
The one door onto the studio: `workflow` names the versioned endpoint, the image parameters are NAMED as the catalogue declares them, and the call is validated against the workflow's contract BEFORE any credit moves — an unknown parameter, a missing required image or an option outside its list is refused with the contract's words.

Answers 202 with a `generation_id`; the result is not in that response. Poll `GET /generations/{id}` every 3–5 s (images ~10–60 s, videos 1–5 min) or pass `webhook_url`.

Credits are debited at submission and refunded on failure; the catalogue carries every price (`x-credits` on each body schema).

Key scope `generate` — the scope that creates and changes things in the studio.

One body schema per workflow below (77 today), discriminated by `workflow`.

put.description:
The WHOLE data object for the section's kind, not a patch. Read the section first (GET /techpacks/{id}) and write back the same keys with the changes; never drop a column or a cell the person made. The canvas is not writable. Shapes by kind — header: { cells: [{ key, label, value }], logo? }; descriptions: { blocks: [{ key, label, body }] }; size_chart, bom: { columns: [{ key, label }], rows: [{ <columnKey>: text }], unit?, note? }; end_notes: { block: { key, label, body } }. Every cell, value and body is text: a number is stored as its text (43 becomes "43"); an object or a list there is refused with 400. No credit moves.

post.description:

With `sketch` it also draws the flat(s) on the canvas. Takes up to three minutes and answers when the pack is written — read it afterwards to check and complete.

Key scope `generate` — the scope that creates and changes things in the studio.

Credits: 1 for the reading, plus 1 per sketch.
